why: State cycle 1 (docs/v3/cycles/state-1.md, P2 state-1.13): `docs/define-controls.md` lists `range({ presets, fallback, custom, params, window })` without saying that a `window` resolver makes `toWindow` return `{ from, to }`, and it names none of the store hooks `useValues()`, `useActiveCount()` and `useReset()`. The build converted presets to dates in 10 lines and read four fields with four `.use()` calls (`OrdersPage.tsx:60-79`); a resolver per preset and one `useValues()` would have done it.
what: The store's doc names its hooks and shows a range resolver.
owns: packages/basalt-ui/src/router/controls/define.ts and field.ts (the JSDoc the doc is generated from)
change: The JSDoc of `defineControls` (and of `field.range`) names `useValues()`, `useActiveCount()` and `useReset()` in one sentence each, and gives one example: a range with `window: { '7d': (now) => ({ from, to }) }` whose `toWindow(value)` yields dates for a query key. Regenerate the doc with its generator; keep it within the shipped-rule and spec-prose budgets (`scripts/check-budgets.ts`).
commits: docs: one commit in packages/basalt-ui (the JSDoc and the regenerated doc).
proof: make check (the agent-doc drift and budget gates).
acceptance: docs/define-controls.md names useValues, useActiveCount and useReset
docs/define-controls.md shows a `window` resolver and what `toWindow` returns with one
